paper_title: Constraining Rapidly Oscillating Scalar Dark Matter Using Dynamic Decoupling
coupling_convention: g_phi_gamma in eV^-1 (Lagrangian (g_phi_gamma/4) phi F F); NOT converted to dimensionless d_e
notes: Paper proposes/demonstrates a dynamic-decoupling method with a trapped 88Sr+ ion + ULE cavity to constrain oscillating scalar DM coupling to photon (g_phi_gamma, Fig 2b/3a) and electron (g_phi_e, Fig 2a) independently, plus relaxion mixing sin(theta) (Fig 2c). Pre-analysis hint ScalarPhoton corresponds to the g_phi_gamma bound (alpha variation). Coupling values are only shown in plots (no tables) and are given in eV^-1, differing from the standard d_e convention; emitted values are ROUGH estimates derived from Eq.4 (g_phi_gamma <= d_alpha*m_phi/sqrt(2 rho_DM)) assuming delta f/f0 ~ 1e-13, so numbers are unreliable. Both a photon and an electron coupling are constrained, lowering confidence. Local DM density rho_DM = 3.1e-6 eV^4 ~ 0.4 GeV/cm^3 (sun's location). Bounds at 95% CL over m_phi ~ 1e-14 to 1e-8 eV (~Hz to MHz).
